scope: crates/sovereign-context immutable per-attempt context/token telemetry over final ContextPacket + RetrievalTrace + typed outcome/use facts
crates/sovereign-eval deterministic versioned aggregation by task/depth/role

metric_contract.ratio_representation: numerator + denominator + optional integer parts_per_million; denominator zero or not-applicable => parts_per_million null
metric_contract.token_accounting: Provider input/output usage is authoritative independently when present. A missing side uses the injected pinned TokenCounter; the default fallback is utf8-ceil4-v1 and the accounting source/tokenizer identity is recorded.
metric_contract.injected_evidence_denominator: Only final packet DirectEvidence/RoutedExpansion/ToolEvidence items participate; C0 and tool schemas are excluded.
metric_contract.used_evidence: Unique typed union of cited, authorized-action-linked, expanded, deterministic-verification-linked, and failure-linked evidence IDs, intersected with final injected evidence. No model prose scraping is used.
metric_contract.context_precision: used evidence tokens / injected evidence tokens
metric_contract.context_waste: injected evidence tokens not in the typed used union / injected evidence tokens
metric_contract.duplicate_context_ratio: duplicate-digest tokens / total candidate tokens before dedupe, including required C0, exactly as architecture section 16 defines it
metric_contract.context_reuse_and_cross_attempt_carry: reused injected evidence tokens / injected evidence tokens
metric_contract.packet_fill: final serialized input tokens / max input tokens
metric_contract.tool_schema_ratio: tool schema tokens / final serialized input tokens
metric_contract.tool_compression: supplied raw output bytes / supplied synopsis bytes; telemetry never reopens tool artifacts
metric_contract.route_hit_quality: verified-success useful selected evidence / raw route selected evidence; failure-linked evidence remains valid overall context use but is not route-useful without verified success

retrieval_routes.final_packet_join: EvidenceChannelLink now binds evidence_id + channel + source_digest + content_digest. Route attribution joins only to the deduplicated final packet and assigns each injected item once to its earliest valid trace link, preventing cross-channel token/use double counting.
retrieval_routes.unavailable_notes: HistoryUnavailable and SemanticUnavailable remain trace steps but are not counted as actual retrieval attempts. SemanticUnavailable therefore is not semantic escalation.
retrieval_routes.stale_unknown: Unknown stale-rejection counts remain null/None rather than fabricated zero and poison aggregate stale-rate observability for that route group.
retrieval_routes.semantic_incremental: Only verified-success attempts can contribute useful semantic items. Useful semantic injected items are content-digest-compared against cheaper injected routes. Failed attempts therefore cannot create semantic incremental value. M2 has no real semantic route, so SemanticUnavailable leaves semantic incremental denominator zero/null.

evaluation_aggregation.ordering: BTreeMap deterministic grouping/route ordering with stable attempt ordering
evaluation_aggregation.zero_success: Verified-task/change/retry/first-pass denominators remain zero with null fixed-point result when there is no verified success/accepted change.

fixture_evidence.provider_precedence_and_fallback: context_metrics_provider_usage_wins_and_typed_use_is_unique_after_packet_dedupe proves input provider count 777 wins exactly while missing output usage falls back to utf8-ceil4-v1.
fixture_evidence.dedupe: Final packet evidence is deduplicated by content digest before telemetry; evidence-only candidate tokens and duplicate removed tokens make the before/after denominator reproducible.
fixture_evidence.single_route_ownership: A trace linking the same final item through multiple channels attributes that item once; a source/content digest mismatch rejects the trace-to-packet join.
fixture_evidence.route_quality: context_metrics_retrieval_hit_quality_uses_route_selected_not_injected_denominator proves selected=2, injected=1, useful=1 => 500000 ppm rather than 1000000 ppm.
fixture_evidence.failed_attempt_use: Failure-linked evidence contributes to overall context use while route useful_selected remains zero and hit-quality fixed point is not applicable without verified success.
fixture_evidence.unavailable_routes: Explicit regressions prove both SemanticUnavailable and HistoryUnavailable notes are steps but not actual semantic/episodic retrieval attempts.
